description: This is a socket client application in C that demonstrates TCP and UDP communication over IPv4 and IPv6. It includes functions for socket creation, connection, message sending, and receiving, with user interaction for configuration.

methods.name: printHelp
methods.description: Displays the main menu options for TCP/UDP communication and exit.

methods.name: printIpv6orIpv4
methods.description: Prompts user to select IPv4 or IPv6 socket creation.

methods.name: createSocketCommunication
methods.description: Creates and manages socket communication based on protocol, IP type, server address, and port.
